fieldServices.title: Industrial Turbine Services: Field Services Capabilities
fieldServices.description: NTP provides responsive on-site engineering services, field overhauls, advanced inspections, and non-destructive examination directly at client operating sites worldwide.

items.title: On Site Overhaul
items.description: Comprehensive mechanical overhaul conducted directly at customer power plant or operating field.

items.title: On Site Coating
items.description: Advanced thermal and protective coating applications deployed directly on operational components.

items.title: On Site Inspection
items.description: Critical dimensional and operational integrity verification performed by certified field specialists.

items.title: Borescope Inspection
items.description: High-resolution video borescope diagnostics for turbine blades, nozzles and combustion chambers without teardown.

items.title: On Site NDI
items.description: Non-Destructive Inspection (NDI) utilizing magnetic particle, dye penetrant, and eddy current methods.

training.title: Aero Engine & Industrial Turbomachinery Training Programs
training.description: Empowering aerospace and heavy industry engineers with hands-on technical competencies, maintenance certifications, and advanced diagnostic training conducted by certified NTP instructors.

items.title: Gas Turbine Operation & Maintenance
items.description: Comprehensive practical program covering gas turbine mechanical assemblies, combustion systems, preventive maintenance protocols, and operational safety.

items.title: Aero Engine Line & Base Maintenance
items.description: Specialized coursework on turboprop and turboshaft propulsion systems, line replaceable units (LRUs), borescope verification, and airworthiness conformity.

items.title: Non-Destructive Inspection & Testing (NDI)
items.description: Hands-on certification in Liquid Penetrant Testing (PT), Magnetic Particle Testing (MT), and Eddy Current Testing (ET) for critical aerospace structures.

items.title: Dynamic Balancing & Vibration Analysis
items.description: Advanced diagnostic training for rotating turbomachinery vibration spectrum interpretation, on-site single/dual plane balancing, and resonance mitigation.

items.title: Protective Coating & Surface Treatment
items.description: Instruction in surface preparation, Sermetel coating applications, curing procedures, and corrosion prevention for gas turbine components.

sections.title: OUR JOURNEY
paragraphs: Established on June 23, 1998, which formerly had been the UMC-IPTN division founded on August 23, 1986. NTP Head Office & Workshop is located at Jl. Pajajaran 154 (KP. IV) Bandung 40174 INDONESIA, adjacent to Husein Sastranegara International Airport.

PT Nusantara Turbin dan Propulsi (NTP), as a globally recognized company in the maintenance of aero engines and industrial rotating equipment, operates an integrated 45,000 m² facility empowered by over 300 highly qualified and certified professionals.

sections.title: CORPORATE OVERVIEW
paragraphs: PT Nusantara Turbin dan Propulsi (NTP) is a trusted excellence center leading Southeast Asia in engineering, maintenance, repair and overhaul of gas turbines, steam turbines, and rotating machinery.

From its founding as the Universal Maintenance Center (UMC) of PT IPTN, NTP has continuously expanded its international certifications to serve defense, commercial aviation, and heavy industrial clients worldwide.
